impactControl.description: Simulated time elapsed relative to the scenario time limit; less elapsed is better. Timed-out sessions score 0.

diagnosticQuality.description: Available evidence requested before the first mitigating action (an action with state effects).

riskManagement.description: Irreversible actions taken only after at least one piece of evidence was gathered.

recoveryQuality.description: Whether the session ended in a terminal state, weighted by terminal mapping.

communication.description: Use of declare/notify/page/escalate-type actions, each with a rationale provided.

learningReflection.description: Share of actions whose rationale was chosen from the offered rationale options.

state-mitigated.debrief: The incident was mitigated and services returned to a healthy state.
